brief: Polycarp was Bishop of Smyrna in Asia Minor for over fifty years. He was born about 70 CE, knew St John in Ephesus, and provides an important link from the apostles to the later church. The refusal of Polycarp and others to take the religious oath to the emperor led to their execution in 156. Urged to curse Christ, Polycarp said, “For eighty-six years I have been his servant, and he has done me no wrong. How can I blaspheme against my king and saviour?”
